mapper.select: select address_id from _address where member_id = #{member_id} and is_default_address = 'true'
mapper.insert: insert into _address(member_id, is_default_address, address_name, postal_code, road_address, detail_address, extra_address, recipient, recipient_phone) values(#{member_id}, #{is_default_address}, #{address_name}, #{postal_code}, #{road_address}, #{detail_address}, #{extra_address}, #{recipient}, #{recipient_phone} )
mapper.select: select * from _address where member_id = #{member_id} order by is_default_address desc
